subject: Go-live orchestration playlist, stakeholders & cutover windows
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Aurora Health — handoff and suggested go-live playlist

Marissa —

Thanks again for taking the lead on Aurora (deal RDW-3421). I’ve attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short summary of the proposed launch sequence. High level: they’ve committed to a November production cutover window and need clear owners for each milestone (integration, data validation, security checklist, go/no-go).

Quick asks for CS to pick up:
- Own the MAP and lock milestone owners/dates with Aurora by next week.
- Confirm whether we need an SLA exception for their reporting cadence (they asked for tighter latency guarantees).
- Coordinate with Aditya on IP allowlist and pre-prod access.

Proposed first pass dates (tentative):
- Integration readiness: Nov 18–20
- UAT/validation: Nov 22–25
- Cutover window: Nov 29–30

I’ve shared the MAP in Drive (link below) — please update and send to Aurora with owners. I’ll remain in the thread for escalations.

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft)
Drive: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/Aurora_MAP_v1

Thanks,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0178

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — handoff and suggested go-live playlist

Vivek —

Got it, thanks. I’ll take point and coordinate the map with Aurora. A couple of clarifying items before I loop in their PMs:

1) Integration owner: who from Aurora will own the SSO/API integration? We need a named contact to schedule dev access.
2) Telemetry/observability: do we have a list of required dashboards/events Aurora expects (errors, token usage by endpoint)? Aditya, can you outline minimal telemetry we should hand off?
3) SLA exception: can you share what they asked for (latency tail or availability)? We’ll assess with Product.

Proposed next steps from CS (please confirm):
- Internal prep call (30m) to align owners & outstanding technical asks — can we do Tue 11/10 at 11am PT?
- Drafted MAP to be sent to Aurora with owners & tentative dates by Fri 11/13.

I’ll prepare an owner matrix and a short acceptance checklist they can sign off on. Putting this on my calendar now.

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Katie Rogers <katie@aurorahealth.com>, Aurora Health IT <it@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — handoff and suggested go-live playlist

Marissa, Vivek —

Thanks — quick responses from our side:
- Integration owner: Katie Rogers (cc’d) will own the integration and will introduce our API lead this week.
- Cutover windows: we prefer Nov 30 (overnight) as primary; Nov 29 backup. We’ll block maintenance windows 11pm–3am ET. I’ve attached a calendar stub (cutover-windows.ics).
- Acceptance criteria (short):
  * Successful end-to-end test with 1k sample requests at expected payloads
  * No P0 errors for 24 hours post-cutover
  * Audit log delivery to our SIEM (S3 transfer or webhook)

Security/compliance: they asked for SOC 2 evidence and a short data retention statement. Our InfoSec will send the questionnaire to Kimberly — expect an intake within 48h.

We’ll need a clear rollback plan and a single Aurora point of contact during cutover.

Samir
Engineering Manager, Aurora Health
samir@aurorahealth.com

Attachment: cutover-windows.ics

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — technical checklist and runbook notes

Marissa —

Following up on telemetry and the integration items Samir mentioned. Technical notes / asks:

- IP allowlist: we need the CIDR block for Aurora’s pre-prod and prod. Without this we can’t provision pre-prod endpoints.
- Runbook: I drafted a short runbook with the recommended cutover sequence (preflight, incremental validation, traffic ramp, monitoring cadence). Link: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/Aurora_Runbooks
- Telemetry: minimal events we’ll hand over: token-level latency (p50/p95), request errors (4xx/5xx), model fallback counts, and audit log delivery confirmations.
- Rollback: recommended rollback is DNS switch to previous endpoint + feature flag disable. Need confirmation on Aurora-side rollback owner.

Proposed milestone table (technical):
- Pre-prod access provisioned — owner: Aurora IT — target: 2026-11-12
- Integration smoke tests — owner: Aditya — target: 2026-11-18
- UAT validation window — owner: Katie — target: 2026-11-22 to 2026-11-25
- Cutover (production) — owner: Aurora Ops — target: 2026-11-30 (primary)

I’ve also flagged a potential SLA item — they asked for 99.9% availability during business hours. Kimberly, I’ve attached the SLA-exception-request.pdf for Ops/Product review.

—Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Katie Rogers <katie@aurorahealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan v1 — owners, milestones & escalation path

Team / Aurora —

Attaching updated MAP (Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx) with owners and the milestone dates we discussed. Please review and confirm the owners below so we can send a formal version to legal and get DocuSign queued.

Summary of agreed items (owner — date):
- Pre-prod access provisioned — Aurora IT (Samir) — 2026-11-12 (done)
- Integration smoke tests — Aditya Rao — 2026-11-18
- UAT validation window — Katie Rogers (Aurora) — 2026-11-22 to 2026-11-25
- Final data validation & audit log check — Kimberly Park — 2026-11-27
- Cutover, production — Aurora Ops (Katie) — 2026-11-30 (primary), 2026-11-29 (backup)

Escalation and SLAs:
- Primary CS contact: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com)
- AE escalation: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com)
- SRE on-call: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com (for cutover)

Open items for Aurora/Redwood legal:
- DocuSign for SOW & MAP (Vivek to push).
- SLA exception request (see attached PDF) — Product review required.
- InfoSec questionnaire — Kimberly to receive from Aurora InfoSec.

Links: DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/transaction?doc=RDW-3421
Drive MAP: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/Aurora_MAP_v1

Please reply with any edits/corrections. If no objections, we’ll send to legal by EOD 11/16 and target DocuSign routing on 11/17.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
CS Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx, SLA-exception-request.pdf

From: Katie Rogers <katie@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@aurorahealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan v1 — owners, milestones & escalation path

Kimberly / team —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming Aurora accepts the milestone owners and dates as written. We’ll lock the primary cutover window on Nov 30 (11pm–3am ET) and keep Nov 29 as backup. I’ve asked our legal to expect the DocuSign envelope from Redwood tomorrow. InfoSec will route the SOC 2 questionnaire to Kimberly within 24 hours.

Please send the final MAP to legal and loop me once DocuSign is out. Looking forward to a smooth cutover.

—Katie
Director of Integrations, Aurora Health
katie@aurorahealth.com
